description: This data contains MATLAB script, functions, microscope images, and X-ray scattering raw data of the publication: "Fast scanning small-angle X-ray scattering of hydrated biological cells". The X-ray scattering data have been collected at ESRF beamline ID13, at beamtime SC5436 (2024 January).

citation.name: B. Yu, M. Sinha, R.M. Da Silva, U. Rölleke, M. Burghammer and S. Köster (2026). J. Synchrotron Rad. 33

distribution.name: Fig2_Fig3_SAXS_RawData.7z
distribution.description: The raw data on X-ray scattering shown in Fig. 2 and 3 are saved in an h5 file format. The step size is 0.5 um and the exposure time is 5 ms. Each h5 file contains 200 patterns corresponding to a single row.

distribution.name: Fig3_FigS9_FigS10_microscope_images.7z
distribution.description: Epifluorescence images shown in Fig.3, Fig. S9 and S10 are saved in a tif format.

distribution.name: image_segmentation.7z
distribution.description: MATLAB functions for cell segmentation based on the ACSAT and watershed methods. The 'glob_loc_ibat.m' function segments cells automatically. It is based on the 'ibat.m' function, which performs intensity-based thresholding, and the 'cyt_label_ascat.m' function, which iterates the thresholding within a limited area.
